title: Snacks were plenty for dinner
text:
Light snacks were perfect for our dinner after coming into Barcelona. Lovely cava ( Spanish champagne) gave us the perfect amount of meat, cheese and olives plus crackers and potato chips ended up being enough for our dinner after getting into Barcelona that morning. 
My husband and I had an Intimate experience with only 2 other lovely young people. We all enjoyed talking as we sailed around the harbor taking in the sights and sipping the cava. 
Got some marvelous photos on the front of the boat taken by the skipper (Giuseppe)
Both the captain (Eduardo) were attentive and lovely to talk to. 
W
author: Darla_L

title: Must Do Experience!
text: Wonderful guide! Amazing experience! Great way to see the water beauty of Barcelona and the skyline views of the city.
author: holli_a

title: First class sail!
text: What a fantastic way to begin our stay in Barcelona! Faith and her sailing partner were excellent hosts, not only serving tasty eats and drinks, but also giving clear safety directives so we could move about the boat while under sail.  Weather also cooperated beautifully and we had an excellent afternoon sail!
author: Deborah_H

title: Highly recommend
text: Captain Faith and Carmelo were great the water was a little rough but it was still very relaxing and beautiful
author: Brenda_H

title: My new best friends
text: Relaxed and entertaining crew on a comfortable boat. Eduardo and Renaldo gave us an exceptionally pleasant cruise that was the highlight of our stay in Barcelona.
author: Mel_B

title: We brought out 5 and 7...
text: We brought out 5 and 7 year old with us, and we had so much fun. Our captains were very kind and let both kids steer the boat for a turn. We had plenty of snacks and drinks, and were pleased that we spent a large proportion of the time out at sea, rather than just touring the harbour. I highly recommend!
author: sschu215

title: Wonderful Sailing
text: This is a wonderful way to spend a few hours in the cool ocean breezes with wonderful people on a humid Barcelona afternoon.  The skipper Nora and her mate Camilo were great, they were so happy and a pleasure to spend time with.  The snacks were delicious and the Cava was quite good.  I truly enjoyed this excursion and would definitely recommend it.
author: CGribben

title: Magical
text: Great service! Great boat! Great Trip! Fun for family or couples. Views are breathtaking and the boat is very nice and well stocked. Book it!
author: MuhammedK

title: Calm seas and beautiful sunsets
text:
This was a very pleasant 2 hour sailing cruise along the Barcelona Harbor.   The sea was calm and the wind was perfect for viewing the sunset on the Mediterranean.   Light snacks and free flowing Proseco added to the ambiance.  
Give it a try!
author: Paul_B

title: Really great crew, great...
text: Really great crew, great snacks, great weather, and nice drinks! This was a great way to see Barcelona and the harbor.
author: Jessica_K
